org_configured.description: True once organization-specific contract playbook limits and jurisdictions are bound.

sheet_map.description: Optional mapping from canonical table key (e.g. invoices) to customer worksheet tab name.

column_map.description: Optional mapping from customer column header or connector JSON field name to canonical engine field name.

lol_cap_months_min.description: Minimum acceptable Limitation of Liability cap in months of trailing fees.

lol_cap_months_max.description: Maximum preferred Limitation of Liability cap in months of fees.

super_cap_multiplier_max.description: Maximum acceptable super-cap multiple over general LoL for data/IP/confidentiality.

max_renewal_notice_days.description: Maximum auto-renewal advance notice window before flagging a redline.

max_price_escalator_pct.description: Maximum annual renewal price uplift / CPI cap percentage.

max_breach_notify_hours.description: Maximum allowed DPA security incident notification window in hours.

forbid_customer_data_training.description: When true, clauses granting vendor AI model training rights on customer data score Score 9.

max_control_evidence_days.description: Maximum age of compliance control test evidence before flagging stale.
